{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Leaderboards

|descr= Requests given leaderboard to download values from global table.

|s1= [[leaderboardRequestRowsGlobal]] [leaderboard, offset, rows]

|p1= leaderboard: [[String]] - name of the leaderboard

|p2= offset: [[Number]] - defines how many rows are skipped

|p3= rows: [[Number]] - defines how many rows are requested

|r1= [[Boolean]] - returns [[true]] if request has been started

|x1= <sqf>_isGettingValues = leaderboardRequestRowsGlobal ["TT01", 0, 10];</sqf>
